class.name: prox_mpc_core/BicycleFrontAxle
class.description: Kinematic bicycle referenced to the front axle: state [x, y, theta, delta] (n=4), control [v, delta_dot] (m=2), with (x, y) at the front-axle centre and v the front-wheel speed. Bundled prox_mpc::Model plugin.

class.name: prox_mpc_core/BicycleRearAxle
class.description: Kinematic bicycle referenced to the rear axle: state [x, y, theta, delta] (n=4), control [v, delta_dot] (m=2), with (x, y) at the rear-axle centre (the base_link origin) and v the body speed. Bundled prox_mpc::Model plugin.

class.name: prox_mpc_core/Bicycle
class.description: Deprecated alias for prox_mpc_core/BicycleFrontAxle, kept so an existing configuration keeps loading; it warns once on load and is removed in the next major release. Select BicycleFrontAxle or BicycleRearAxle instead.

class.name: prox_mpc_core/Unicycle
class.description: Unicycle (differential-drive) reference model: state [x, y, theta] (n=3), control [v, omega] (m=2). Bundled prox_mpc::Model plugin.
